question: Who composed the track "'Round Midnight"?
gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Name = '''Round Midnight'

question: What is the title of the album with AlbumId 100?
gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE AlbumId = 100

question: What city does the customer named Kara Nielsen live in?
gold_sql: SELECT City FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Kara' AND LastName = 'Nielsen'

question: How many customers are in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: How many tracks cost more than one dollar?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 1.0

question: How many invoices were billed to the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA'

question: What is the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the highest total sales?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has spent the most money?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much total revenue did the artist 'Led Zeppelin' generate?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Led Zeppelin'

question: Which genre generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who does Jane Peacock report to?
gold_sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock'

question: How many employees report directly to Nancy Edwards?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

question: Which employee has no manager?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NULL

question: How many artists have no albums?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId)

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: How many tracks are in the playlist called 'Music'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music'
notes: Two playlists are named 'Music' (ids 1 and 8). Gold counts tracks in both.

question: How many playlists are named 'Music'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist WHERE Name = 'Music'
notes: Tests whether the model notices the duplicate name.

question: Who composed the track 'Black Dog'?
gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Black Dog'
notes: Two tracks are named 'Black Dog' with different Composer values. Gold returns both rows.

question: In which year was total sales highest?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2024-01-01'

question: Which month of 2023 had the highest total sales?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%m', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2023-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are longer than the average track length?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track)

question: How many tracks are longer than the average length of tracks in their own genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(t2.Milliseconds) FROM Track t2 WHERE t2.GenreId = t.GenreId)

question: How many customers spent more than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s2) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) s2 FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock') / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine)

question: What fraction of tracks are longer than five minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Milliseconds > 300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: What percentage of customers are in the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: Which tracks are the most expensive? List all of them.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice = (SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track)
notes: 213 tracks tie at the maximum UnitPrice. Gold returns the full tie set.

question: How many customers are tied for having the most invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(*) c FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE c = (SELECT MAX(c2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) c2 FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))
notes: 58 customers tie at the maximum invoice count.
